title: Fixed-Open Single-Sash Cold Frame
description: One newly authored complete low garden cold-frame appearance: a continuous open-centre ground footing carries two genuinely wedge-topped timber sides, low front and high back. A single whole open-centre framed sash with centre mullion and two thick pale glass-look infills is held well open above the planting cavity by two finite rear barrel brackets and a fixed stay. Not a scaled gabled greenhouse, detached greenhouse door, flattened bakery case or seedling tray with extra boards; all dimensions and whole construction newly authored. The planting interior/bottom are actually open and empty, no soil or crops imported. Pale blue pane appearance uses explicitly opaque solid PBR, not physical transmission or real-time transparency. Metres Z up, true whole XY bounds-centred, whole footing sole Z0. One static reusable prop, not a scene. No hinge motion, ventilation/climate/growth performance, safe access, engineering, weather or glass safety claim.
